key: CHARLOTTE: Nice timing.
en: CHARLOTTE: Nice timing.
ja: シャルロット: いいタイミング。

key: I just finished setting everything up.
en: I just finished setting everything up.
ja: ちょうど全部準備し終わったところ。

key: When you're downstairs, you'll find four minecarts with explosives stuffed into them.
en: When you're downstairs, you'll find four minecarts with explosives stuffed into them.
ja: 下に行けば、爆薬を詰め込んだトロッコが4台あるはず。

key: I've already primed them or whatever, so don't worry about that.
en: I've already primed them or whatever, so don't worry about that.
ja: 起爆準備はもう済ませてあるから、そこは心配しないで。

key: All you need to do is find a way to slam those carts into the pillar in the center.
en: All you need to do is find a way to slam those carts into the pillar in the center.
ja: あんたはあのトロッコを中央の柱にぶつける方法を見つけるだけでいい。

key: You'll probably need all four, but the tracks are a bit messed up.
en: You'll probably need all four, but the tracks are a bit messed up.
ja: たぶん4台とも必要だと思うけど、線路がちょっと壊れてるの。

key: I could've fixed it myself but it looked annoying, so... yeah.
en: I could've fixed it myself but it looked annoying, so...  yeah.
ja: 自分で直すこともできたけど、面倒くさそうだったから…まあ、そういうこと。

key: Tag; you're it.
en: Tag; you're it.
ja: はい、これであんたの番。

key: CHARLOTTE: Oh, and by the way?
en: CHARLOTTE: Oh, and by the way?
ja: シャルロット: あ、それとね?

key: There's not exactly an easy way down there.
en: There's not exactly an easy way down there.
ja: そこまで下りる簡単な道はないから。

key: Hope you land on your feet.
en: Hope you land on your feet.
ja: うまく着地できるといいね。

key: CHARLOTTE: All you gotta do is slam the four minecarts with explosives into the pillar downstairs.
en: CHARLOTTE: All you gotta do is slam the four minecarts with explosives into the pillar downstairs.
ja: シャルロット: あんたは爆薬を積んだ4台のトロッコを、下の柱にぶつけるだけでいい。

key: You'll have to do some jumping to get there,
en: You'll have to do some jumping to get there,
ja: そこまで行くのにちょっとジャンプが必要だし、

key: And some finagling with the tracks, but...
en: And some finagling with the tracks, but...
ja: 線路もあれこれいじらなきゃだけど…

key: Whatever. You're good at that stuff, right?
en: Whatever. You're good at that stuff, right?
ja: まあいいか。そういうの得意でしょ?

key: I'm just gonna chill out for a few.
en: I'm just gonna chill out for a few.
ja: あたしはちょっとのんびりしてるから。

key: CHARLOTTE: I heard the fireworks.
en: CHARLOTTE: I heard the fireworks.
ja: シャルロット: 花火の音、聞こえたわよ。

key: Hope you had a good time?
en: Hope you had a good time?
ja: 楽しめた?

key: I'm pretty sure if we head to where they were camped up on the top of the pillar, we should be able to get over it and chase after them now.
en: I'm pretty sure if we head to where they were camped up on the top of the pillar, we should be able to get over it and chase after them now.
ja: あいつらが陣取ってた柱の上まで行けば、もう乗り越えて追いかけられるはずよ。

key: Saphira said to follow the yellow brick road, right?
en: Saphira said to follow the yellow brick road, right?
ja: サファイラが黄色いレンガの道をたどれって言ってたよね?

key: Race you there.
en: Race you there.
ja: 競争ね。

key: Life is a gamble.
en: Life is a gamble.
ja: 人生は賭けだ。

key: Whether we win or lose, it is based on sheer luck.
en: Whether we win or lose, it is based on sheer luck.
ja: 勝つも負けるも、すべては運次第。

key: Black and white... It's all the same.
en: Black and white... It's all the same.
ja: 黒も白も…結局は同じこと。

key: I believe in a world of gray, and I will not stop until I reach it.
en: I believe in a world of gray, and I will not stop until I reach it.
ja: 俺は灰色の世界を信じている。そこにたどり着くまで、俺は止まらない。

key: Prepare to get one of your three daily servings of FRUIT!
en: Prepare to get one of your three daily servings of FRUIT!
ja: 1日3食分のフルーツのうちの1つを受け取る準備をしろ!

key: Delicious.
en: Delicious.
ja: 美味い。

key: An old area map is posted here...
en: An old area map is posted here...
ja: 古いエリアマップが貼られている…

key: ...But it doesn't seem to be accurate anymore.
en: ...But it doesn't seem to be accurate anymore.
ja: …でも、もう正確ではないようだ。

key: This rock is glowing with energy inside...
en: This rock is glowing with energy inside...
ja: この　いわの　なかで　エネルギーが　かがやいている……

key: Do you want to mine the rock?
en: Do you want to mine the rock?
ja: いわを　さいくつしますか？

key: It seems too sturdy to break or move...
en: It seems too sturdy to break or move...
ja: 頑丈すぎて壊したり動かしたりできそうにない…

key: The rock base may hold more valuables. Do you want to open it with Blast Powder?
en: The rock base may hold more valuables. Do you want to open it with Blast Powder?
ja: 岩の土台の中にはお宝があるかもしれない。ばくはつのこなで開ける?

key: Pillar destruction has been detected from a different save file.
en: Pillar destruction has been detected from a different save file.
ja: 別のセーブファイルで柱の破壊が確認された。

key: Skip minecart puzzles on this file?
en: Skip minecart puzzles on this file?
ja: このファイルでトロッコパズルをスキップする?

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
